invariants.rationale: At this program point, no matter the path, element.getName() may or may not equal 'group'; this expression is always defined and avoids NPE.
parentLayers is used as a receiver and thus must not be null.
element is dereferenced, so it must not be null at this point.
map is used in loadLayer calls and must not be null.
imageResolver is passed into loadLayer and cannot be null at this point.
